scope: Qualify only the Root-approved neutral marker-gutter change and the affected native tag surfaces before any complete C6 round.
preparation_status: Static preparation; an owner-provided frozen executable and explicit App GO are mandatory before execution.

provisional_product.binary_sha256: Await the final-validation owner's actual frozen C6 executable SHA256.

main_recipe_correction: Preserve the actual all-neutral native outline observation and every ordered-ID assertion. Replay the measured chip centers from right to left, so selection's real marker expansion cannot move a still-neutral target before its click. No semantic filter-choice fallback is permitted.
freshness_and_identity: Reject a nonempty, non-directory or symlink output before constructing the Suite. Never overwrite an earlier incomplete attempt without a manifest.
Require complete expected source and binary SHA256 values and the inherited Linux/xvfb guard. No local verification or application execution is permitted.

Bind the driver, main, pixel observer, five actually loaded helpers, formal plan and reference scope before and after the run. Product, references and native PNG identities remain separately bound by the main manifest.
All runtime data is newly created below output/data/<new-run-id>. Original C4/C5 evidence and candidates remain unchanged.

normal_capacity.complete_formula: 2 original neutral references + sum(seed + online + 2 * actual_normal_pages + excluded + 2 long-variant captures) over PW and Scribe

native_cases.purpose: Capture the actual fresh C6 Chinese neutral tags from the original recipes, including intrinsic width, centered labels and the original source-filter geometry. Old C5 images provide no C6 execution credit.

Use the existing real loopback provider and all 34 actual metadata tags. Bootstrap through real HTTP, retain each neutral native observation, replay every actual measured chip, and require the complete ordered continuous ID collection exactly once through the real final page.
Tap the measured first neutral chip twice using real native press/release events. Require only that real ID to be excluded, and inspect its retained cross, dashed outline and label strike.

After both normal full collections complete, a separate real HTTP metadata variant replaces exactly one tag while retaining 34 total. Retain the original and sent response JSON with exact bytes/SHA and request index. Inspect the actual DISTINCT-SUFFIX-00 ending and bounded truncation, then reach excluded through the measured native chip center.

pixel_contracts: Inspect original native PNGs only; never render, retouch or repair their text, outlines or marker pixels.

For ordinary nonoverflowing neutral tags, measure actual dark glyph bounds against the chip rectangle: center error at most three native pixels, and width slack between -2 and 8 pixels after declared padding to account for native glyph bearings.

Observe real black selected fill and contrasting white checkmark pixels, and preserve the actual selected marker width. Observe real gray excluded cross, four dashed edges and the native strike at that same marker allocation.
Long overflow labels keep their intentional bounded suffix clipping. Text in provider JSON or State never substitutes for independent readability inspection of the original long-tag PNGs.

result_contract.focused_exit_zero: Only the affected-tag assertions and immutable-input gates succeeded.
result_contract.manual_review: Root/coordinator inspect the fresh affected original PNGs in bounded batches. This qualification cannot count as either complete full round.

resource_bounds: Run only in the final-validation owner's authorized desktop window. Do not start Native VM work, formal timing, a full round, or data cleanup. Keep the existing per-process 90-second limit and all main reader/source/HTTP assertions unchanged.
